blurb:
Experience Cannery Row on a guided walking food tour featuring local seafood, wine, artisan treats, and Monterey history.

Step into the pages of Steinbeck and explore the sights, sounds, and flavors of Monterey’s most famous waterfront street. You'll meander through Cannery Row’s historic blocks, learn little-known stories of John Steinbeck and Ed Ricketts, and uncover fascinating glimpses into the area's past — from bustling sardine canneries to today’s vibrant marine life and kelp forests.

Along the way, enjoy a curated lineup of tastings, including clam chowder, Baja fish tacos, local wine, artisan honey, handcrafted snacks, and sweet treats from beloved local businesses. You'll even raise a glass with a special toast to Monterey Bay.

Whether you're a foodie, a history lover, or simply looking for a unique way to experience Monterey, this tour blends coastal charm, local culture, and unforgettable bites — all in one scenic afternoon.
